assessment_objectives.objective: sources of new threats and vulnerabilities are defined.
a time period is defined to seek out new, applicable threats and vulnerabilities.
a capability exists to respond to new threats and vulnerabilities on an ongoing basis.
system vulnerabilities are remediated within organization-defined response times.
assessment_objectives.scf_defined_parameters: no more than 30 days for critical and high severity vulnerabilities; no more than 90 days for medium and low severity vulnerabilities

assessment_objectives.objective: system vulnerabilities are remediated within <A.03.11.02.ODP[03]: response times>.
assessment_objectives.scf_defined_parameters: thirty (30) days from date of discovery for high-risk vulnerabilities (including both critical and high); 90 days from date of discovery for moderate-risk vulnerabilities; and 180 days from date of discovery for low-risk vulnerabilities
assessment_objectives.org_defined_parameters: US DoD ODP Value: thirty (30) days from date of discovery for high-risk vulnerabilities (including both critical and high); 90 days from date of discovery for moderate-risk vulnerabilities; and 180 days from date of discovery for low-risk vulnerabilities
